compiled_state.description:
## Problem

A late LLM-review event for an old patchset can dispatch Gerrit Verified for that stale revision. Because Verified concurrency is keyed by change, the stale run supersedes and cancels useful work for the current patchset. This wastes scarce runners and can leave the current patchset without a complete CI verdict.

## Experimentally verified evidence

On Gerrit change 2225, current patchset 6 canonical Verified run 32926871119 started at 2026-08-26T03:33:08Z. The review bot finished and published an LLM-Review result for old patchset 5 at 03:43:46Z. GitHub run 32927544184 was created at 03:43:48Z; its completed ticket-validation job records `gerrit-refspec: refs/changes/25/2225/5`, proving it targets stale patchset 5. Run 32926871119 then reported `Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for gerrit-verify-rebar~2225 exists`; its mutation shard was canceled after 8m45s and its still-running Linux jobs were canceled.

Correction to the initial observation: four other runs created around 03:42:48-03:42:54 belong to other Gerrit changes (for example, run 32927478228 records `refs/changes/26/2226/3`). They are not duplicates for change 2225 and are excluded from this bug. The verified defect is one stale-PS5 run superseding the active PS6 run.

Related precedent `musophobic-secondary-jaguar` fixed the narrower `recheck-review` ChatOps word collision. This occurrence involves a late ordinary review result for a non-current revision and is therefore a distinct revision-filter/concurrency defect.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A late review result for a non-current patchset does not dispatch Verified for that stale revision.
- [ ] A stale-patchset event cannot supersede or cancel the current patchset's Verified run.
- [ ] A new current patchset still dispatches exactly one canonical Verified run.
- [ ] The authorized CI recheck mechanism for the current patchset still dispatches exactly one replacement run.
- [ ] Tests replay PS5 review completion while PS6 CI is active and assert that PS6 remains active and no PS5 Verified dispatch occurs.
- [ ] Diagnostics record the event revision, current revision, event type, and accepted/suppressed disposition without adding material runtime work.
compiled_state.title: Late LLM review of stale patchset supersedes current Verified run
